description: A selfie at a lakeside campsite on a sunny autumn day. A smiling young woman in a mustard beanie, a red puffer vest and a cream fleece holds the camera. Behind her an orange pop-up tent flies through the air, lands and stands fully open in a second. A young man in a green sweater cheers with both fists up, a young man in a navy sweater holding a pile of tangled green tent poles stares with his mouth open, and a spotted dog runs around the tent. Leaves fall, and a misty lake and a wooden jetty lie behind them.
